scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:secrets
scripts.format: npm run format:web && npm run format:python
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:web && npm run format:check:python
scripts.format:check:python: uv run ruff format --check apps tests scripts migrations
scripts.format:python: uv run ruff format apps tests scripts migrations
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: uv run ruff check apps tests scripts migrations
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:python
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:python
scripts.typecheck:python: uv run mypy apps tests scripts migrations
